chapters.title: God comes in judgment
chapters.summary: God comes down to judge Samaria and Jerusalem for their idolatry. Micah mourns as the disaster reaches the gate of Jerusalem.

chapters.title: Woe to the oppressors
chapters.summary: Woe to those who plan to seize fields and houses. Yet God will gather the remnant of Israel like sheep, with their king before them.

chapters.title: Corrupt leaders
chapters.summary: Rulers hate good and love evil, and prophets preach for money. Because of them, Zion will be plowed like a field.

chapters.title: Swords into ploughshares
chapters.summary: In the last days nations will come to God's mountain to learn His ways. They will beat their swords into ploughshares, and everyone will sit under their own vine.

chapters.title: From Bethlehem
chapters.summary: From little Bethlehem will come a ruler whose origins are from of old. He will shepherd His flock in the strength of the Lord and be their peace.

chapters.title: What does the Lord require?
chapters.summary: God brings a case against His people. What does He require? To do justly, to love mercy, and to walk humbly with your God.

chapters.title: Who is a God like You?
chapters.summary: Micah waits for God in a corrupt time. Who is a God like You, who pardons iniquity and casts all our sins into the depths of the sea?
